errors.description: Measured as raw pixel area the two welt-and-flap bars are about 8% of the frame, because a besom pocket is an inherently thin horizontal element.
errors.expected: Option zone dominating 40-80% of the frame.
errors.actual: The pocket band spans the full frame width and the waistcoat lower front now fills roughly three quarters of the frame with no competing element; the pockets are the only features besides the closure.
errors.correction: No further tightening is possible without cropping out one of the two pockets and destroying the count, which is the more important checklist item. Framing target considered met in substance.

notes: Attempt 2 applies both logged corrections. Explicit counts re-verified against the drawing: exactly 2 flapped besom pockets, exactly 2 buttons plus 1 empty buttonhole, exactly 2 hem points with a centre notch. The red outlines in the blueprint were correctly treated as option highlights, not colour instructions - both pockets are navy cloth. Flap depth is the distinguishing feature against the plain-welt sibling and is now rendered with clear relief and shadow.
